groups.title: Move buildQueryString to src/utils/query.ts
groups.why: The function is deleted from http/client.ts and re-created unchanged in utils/query.ts; both importers (client.ts, userService.ts) switch to the new path, and its tests move from client.test.ts to query.test.ts.

groups.title: Raise default HTTP timeout to 10s
groups.why: One-line default change, unrelated to the refactor.

groups.title: Mechanical changes
groups.why: Pure file rename strings.test.ts -> strings.spec.ts (100% similarity, no content change).

notes: The deleted and added copies of buildQueryString are textually identical: a strong signal for embeddings and for a move detector, but they live in different directories, so path proximity works against them.
src/config/defaults.ts#0 is a singleton: the ideal output is its own group (or misc). It should not be glued to src/http/client.ts just because both mention HTTP.
